bullets.text: Portfolio contacted (12 months) held steady at 87.5%, ranking 3 among 10 peers, with Western Quebec highest of the three districts at 89.2%.
Show rate fell 2.5% to 93.4% this week, while the no-show rate rose 56.1% to 6.62%.
Greater Montréal's show rate fell 6.0% to 91.3%, the lowest of the three districts, while Western Quebec's rose to 98.6%.
Appointment conversion fell 15.2% to 20.2% this week, and activities per advisor rose 10.4% to 18.0.

answer.headline: Quebec's portfolio contacted (12 months) held steady this week at 87.5%.
